query: SELECT c.id, c.pid FROM contacts c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.merged_into_pid IS NULL AND c.id > $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_runs r WHERE r.workflow_pid = $1 AND r.subject_pid = c.pid AND r.outcome IN ('done', 'failed') AND r.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => $3)) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT $4
